<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en" data-theme="light" style="color-scheme: light;"><head><meta charset="utf8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover"><style>:root{color-scheme:light;box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)}body{margin:0;padding:0;font:14px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,sans-serif;background:#fff;color:#000}img{max-width:100%}[hidden]:not([hidden=until-found i]){display:none!important}</style></head><body>



<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="color-scheme" content="light">
<title>Cato Digital: GPU Equipment Financing Brief</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin="">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:opsz,wght@9..144,500;9..144,600;9..144,700&amp;family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500&amp;display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{
  --page:#F4F0E8; --paper:#FBF9F4; --ink:#1C1410; --muted:#4A3F36; --accent:#7E32D3; --rule:#CFC6B6;
  --sand:#E6DDCB; --stone:#8A7B6A; --ok:#2E6B4F; --amber:#B7791F;
  --serif:'Fraunces',Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;
  --sans:'Helvetica Neue',Arial,system-ui,sans-serif;
  --mono:'IBM Plex Mono',ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace;
  box-sizing:border-box;
  padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);
  padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px);
}
html{color-scheme:light;scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);height:100%}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;font-style:normal}
body{margin:0;min-height:100%;background:var(--page);color:var(--ink);font:12.5px/1.55 var(--sans);-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.01em;margin:0;color:var(--ink)}
p{margin:0 0 8px;text-wrap:balance}
b,strong{font-weight:700}
.sheet{max-width:1120px;margin:0 auto;padding:30px 36px 20px;background:var(--page);border-bottom:2px solid var(--rule)}
.head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:24px;border-bottom:2px solid var(--ink);padding-bottom:12px;margin-bottom:16px}
.kicker{font:500 10.5px/1.3 var(--mono);letter-spacing:.09em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
h1{font-size:29px;line-height:1.15;max-width:760px;text-wrap:balance;margin-top:6px}
.head .side{font:500 10.5px/1.4 var(--mono);letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);text-align:right;white-space:nowrap}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px}
.quad{background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--rule);border-top:3px solid var(--ink);padding:14px 16px 14px;min-width:0}
.quad h2{font-size:17px;line-height:1.25;margin:0 0 9px;display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:baseline;text-wrap:balance}
.num{font:500 12px/1 var(--mono);color:var(--accent);letter-spacing:.04em}
.strip{text-wrap:balance;margin-top:14px;border-left:5px solid var(--accent);background:var(--paper);border-top:1px solid var(--rule);border-right:1px solid var(--rule);border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule);padding:12px 18px;font:500 14.5px/1.5 var(--serif);text-wrap:pretty}
.strip .lab{display:block;font:500 10px/1 var(--mono);letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:6px}
.foot{margin-top:12px;font-size:10.5px;line-height:1.45;color:var(--muted);text-wrap:balance}
.cap{font-size:10.5px;line-height:1.4;color:var(--muted);margin:4px 0 0;text-wrap:balance}
.mono{font-family:var(--mono)}
/* stats */
.row2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:14px;align-items:start;margin:8px 0}
.stat{border-top:1px solid var(--rule);padding:7px 0 6px}
.stat:first-child{border-top:0;padding-top:0}
.stat .big{font:600 22px/1.1 var(--serif);color:var(--accent)}
.stat .big.ink{color:var(--ink)}
.stat p{font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.4;margin:3px 0 0;color:var(--muted);text-wrap:balance}
/* flow boxes */
.flow{display:flex;align-items:stretch;gap:0;margin:8px 0 6px}
.flow .bx{flex:1;border:1px solid var(--ink);padding:6px 8px;font-size:11px;line-height:1.3;background:var(--page);text-align:center}
.flow .bx b{display:block;font-size:11.5px}
.flow .ar{flex:0 0 58px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font:500 9.5px/1.15 var(--mono);color:var(--muted);text-align:center;letter-spacing:.02em}
.flow .ar::after{content:"";display:block;width:44px;border-top:1.5px solid var(--accent);margin-top:3px;position:relative}
.chips{font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.5;margin:6px 0 0}
.chips b{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);font-weight:500}
/* risk tiles */
.tiles{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px 14px}
.tile{border-left:2px solid var(--accent);padding:1px 0 1px 9px}
.tile b{display:block;font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.3}
.tile span.d{display:block;font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.4;color:var(--muted);text-wrap:balance}
.tile .n{font:500 10px/1 var(--mono);color:var(--accent);margin-right:5px}
/* proof list */
ol.proof{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;counter-reset:p}
ol.proof li{counter-increment:p;position:relative;padding:5px 0 5px 26px;border-top:1px solid var(--rule);font-size:12px;line-height:1.45;text-wrap:balance}
ol.proof li:first-child{border-top:0;padding-top:0}
ol.proof li::before{content:counter(p);position:absolute;left:0;top:5px;font:500 12px/1 var(--mono);color:var(--accent)}
ol.proof li:first-child::before{top:0}
ol.proof li b{font-weight:700}
ul.plain{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
ul.plain li{padding:5px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--rule);font-size:12px;line-height:1.45;text-wrap:balance}
ul.plain li:first-child{border-top:0;padding-top:0}
/* bars */
.hb .hr{display:grid;grid-template-columns:104px minmax(0,1fr);gap:10px;align-items:start;margin-bottom:9px}
.hb .hl{font-size:11px;line-height:1.25;color:var(--muted)}
.hb .hl b{display:block;color:var(--ink);font-size:11.5px}
.hb .bw{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:20px}
.hb .br{height:20px;background:var(--ink);flex:0 0 auto}
.hb .br.red{background:var(--accent)}
.hb .br.stone{background:var(--stone)}
.hb .amt{font:700 12.5px/1 var(--sans);white-space:nowrap;color:var(--ink)}
.hb .sub{font-size:10.5px;line-height:1.3;color:var(--muted);margin-top:2px}
.seg{display:flex;height:24px;margin:2px 0 3px;border:1px solid var(--ink)}
.seg span{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font:600 10.5px/1 var(--sans);color:var(--paper);overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap}
.seg .a{background:var(--accent)}.seg .b{background:var(--ink)}.seg .c{background:var(--stone)}
.seg.pipe{border:1px dashed var(--ink);background:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,var(--sand) 0 6px,var(--paper) 6px 12px);justify-content:flex-start}
.seg.pipe span{background:none;color:var(--ink);padding-left:8px;justify-content:flex-start;width:100%}
table.t{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.35;margin-top:6px}
table.t th{font:500 9.5px/1.2 var(--mono);letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);text-align:left;padding:4px 6px 4px 0;border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--ink)}
table.t td{padding:4px 6px 4px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule);vertical-align:top}
table.t td.r,table.t th.r{text-align:right;padding-right:0}
.pill{display:inline-block;font:500 9.5px/1 var(--mono);letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:3px 5px;border:1px solid var(--ink);margin-left:4px;vertical-align:1px}
.pill.go{background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper)}
/* steps */
.steps{display:flex;gap:0;margin:8px 0 2px}
.steps div{flex:1;font-size:10.5px;line-height:1.3;text-align:center;padding:6px 6px 6px 10px;background:var(--sand);border:1px solid var(--rule);position:relative;margin-right:-1px}
.steps div:first-child{padding-left:6px}
.steps div b{display:block;font:500 9.5px/1 var(--mono);color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:3px}
.rk{display:inline-block;margin-left:7px;font:500 9.5px/1 var(--mono);letter-spacing:.05em;color:var(--accent);border:1px solid var(--accent);padding:2px 4px;vertical-align:1px;white-space:nowrap}
.tests{margin-top:10px;border-top:1px solid var(--rule);padding-top:8px;font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.5}
.tests b{font:500 10px/1 var(--mono);letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
/* tiles row page 3 */
.kpis{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px;margin:6px 0 8px}
.kpi{border:1px solid var(--rule);background:var(--page);padding:7px 8px}
.kpi .big{font:600 19px/1.1 var(--serif);color:var(--accent)}
.kpi p{font-size:11px;line-height:1.35;margin:3px 0 0;color:var(--muted);text-wrap:balance}
.snap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:10px;margin-top:14px}
.snap div{border-top:3px solid var(--ink);background:var(--paper);padding:8px 10px;font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.4;border-left:1px solid var(--rule);border-right:1px solid var(--rule);border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule)}
.snap b{display:block;font:500 10px/1.2 var(--mono);letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:4px}
svg{display:block;max-width:100%;height:auto}
svg text{font-family:var(--sans)}

/* exhibits */
.figs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px;align-items:start}
.fig{margin:0;background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--rule);border-top:3px solid var(--ink);padding:10px 10px 8px;min-width:0;break-inside:avoid}
.fig.wide{grid-column:1/-1}
.fig.narrow .art,.fig.narrow figcaption{max-width:700px;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}
.fig figcaption{font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.45;margin-top:7px;text-wrap:balance}
.fig figcaption b{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:13.5px}
.art{position:relative;container-type:inline-size;width:100%}
.art img{width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
.hero{width:100%;height:170px;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 45%;display:block}
.lb{position:absolute;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;white-space:nowrap;line-height:1;font-family:var(--sans);font-weight:600;overflow:hidden}
.lb.dk{background:#241B17;color:#FBF9F4;font-family:var(--serif);border-radius:1.1cqw}
.lb.tp{background:#92806F;color:#1C1410;border-radius:.9cqw}
.lb.td{background:#6D5E50;color:#FBF9F4;border-radius:.9cqw}
.lb.rd{background:#7E32D3;color:#FBF9F4;border-radius:.9cqw}
.lb.lt{background:#D4CABD;color:#1C1410;border-radius:.9cqw}
.lb.ouR{background:#FBF9F4;color:#7E32D3;border-radius:99cqw}
.lb.ouM{background:#F7F4EE;color:#4A3F36;border-radius:99cqw}
.lb.mr,.lb.mm{background:#8E806F;color:#1C1410;border-radius:.7cqw}
.lb.mr{font-weight:700}
.lb.nm{color:#FBF9F4;background:none;font-weight:700}
.ovl{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%}
.ic{display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:flex-start}
.ic .icn{width:38px;height:38px;flex:0 0 38px;margin-top:0}
@media screen and (max-width:860px){.figs{grid-template-columns:1fr}.hero{height:150px}}
@media print{#p4 .fig{break-inside:avoid}}

/* v2 additions */
.ph{display:inline-block;border:1.5px dashed var(--accent);color:var(--accent);padding:1px 6px;font:500 10.5px/1.4 var(--mono);background:var(--paper)}
.dean{display:grid;grid-template-columns:92px 1fr;gap:12px;align-items:start;margin-bottom:8px}
.dean img{width:92px;height:92px;object-fit:cover;display:block;border:1px solid var(--ink)}
.dean .nm{font:600 13.5px/1.25 var(--serif)}
.dean .rl{font:500 9.5px/1.35 var(--mono);letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:4px}
.paths{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;margin:8px 0}
.paths>div{padding:8px 10px;font-size:11px;line-height:1.4;border:1px solid var(--ink)}
.paths .a{background:var(--sand)}
.paths .c{background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper)}
.paths .h{display:block;font:500 9.5px/1 var(--mono);letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:4px}
.paths .c .h{color:#E6DDCB}.paths .a .h{color:var(--accent)}
.paths b{display:block;font:600 12.5px/1.25 var(--serif);margin-bottom:3px}
.lives{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);margin:6px 0 4px}
.lives>div{padding:8px 10px;font-size:11px;line-height:1.35;border:1px solid var(--ink);margin-right:-1px}
.lives .h{display:block;font:500 9.5px/1 var(--mono);letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:5px}
.lives b{display:block;font:600 12.5px/1.25 var(--serif);margin-bottom:3px}
.lives .l1{background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper)}.lives .l1 .h{color:#E6DDCB}
.lives .l2{background:var(--accent);color:var(--paper)}.lives .l2 .h{color:#F4F0E8}
.lives .l3{background:var(--sand)}.lives .l3 .h{color:var(--accent)}
.fade{height:8px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--ink),var(--stone) 60%,var(--sand));margin:2px 0 3px}
.fadel{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font:500 9.5px/1.2 var(--mono);color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.04em}
.supply{display:flex;align-items:stretch;gap:0;margin:8px 0}
.supply .bx{flex:1;border:1.5px dashed var(--accent);padding:7px 8px;font-size:11px;line-height:1.3;text-align:center;background:var(--paper)}
.supply .bx.s{border:1px solid var(--ink);border-style:solid;background:var(--page)}
.supply .bx b{display:block;font-size:11.5px}
.supply .ar{flex:0 0 40px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.supply .ar::after{content:"";display:block;width:30px;border-top:1.5px solid var(--accent)}
.hb .br.hatch{background:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,var(--stone) 0 6px,var(--sand) 6px 12px);border:1px solid var(--stone)}
.hb .hl .k{font:500 10px/1 var(--mono);color:var(--accent);margin-right:4px}
a{color:inherit}
.edtools{position:fixed;right:14px;bottom:14px;z-index:50;display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--ink);padding:6px 8px;font:500 11px/1.2 var(--mono,monospace);box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(28,20,16,.18)}
.edtools button{font:inherit;border:1px solid var(--ink);background:var(--page,#F4F0E8);color:var(--ink);padding:5px 9px;cursor:pointer}
.edtools button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper)}
.edtools button[hidden]{display:none}
.edtools #ed-m{max-width:230px;color:var(--muted,#8A7B6A)}
body.editing .sheet[contenteditable]:focus{outline:none}
body.editing .sheet[contenteditable] :is(h1,h2,p,li,td,th,b,.sub,.cap,.foot,.nm,.rl,.lab,.strip,.hl,.amt,.big):hover{outline:1px dashed rgba(126,50,211,.55);outline-offset:2px}
@media print{.edtools{display:none!important}}
.next4{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:10px}
.next4>div{border:1px solid var(--rule);border-top:3px solid var(--accent);background:var(--page);padding:8px 10px;font-size:11px;line-height:1.4}
.next4 .k{display:block;font:500 9.5px/1.2 var(--mono);color:var(--accent);letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase}
.next4 .big{font:600 19px/1.15 var(--serif);margin:3px 0;color:var(--ink)}
@media screen and (max-width:860px){.next4{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
/* v7 additions */
.lad{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);margin:7px 0 3px}
.lad>div{padding:6px 6px;font-size:10.5px;line-height:1.3;border:1px solid var(--ink);margin-right:-1px;background:var(--sand);text-wrap:balance}
.lad>div b{display:block;font:500 9.5px/1 var(--mono);color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:3px}
.lad>div.k4{background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper)}.lad>div.k4 b{color:#E6DDCB}
.lad>div.k5{background:var(--accent);color:var(--paper)}.lad>div.k5 b{color:#F4F0E8}
ol.proof ul.sub{list-style:none;margin:3px 0 0;padding:0}
ol.proof ul.sub li{counter-increment:none;position:static;padding:1px 0;border-top:0;font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.4;display:flex;gap:6px}
ol.proof ul.sub li::before{content:"\2013";position:static;font:inherit;color:var(--accent);flex:0 0 auto}
.band{margin:10px 0 6px;padding-top:6px;border-top:2px solid var(--ink)}
.band h2{font-size:17px;line-height:1.25}
.row3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.45fr 1fr;gap:14px}
.row3 .quad{min-width:0}
.row3 ol.proof li{font-size:11.5px}
.foot a,ol.proof a,.quad a{color:inherit;text-decoration:underline;text-decoration-color:var(--accent);text-underline-offset:2px}
@media screen and (max-width:860px){.row3{grid-template-columns:1fr}.lad{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
@media print{.row3{grid-template-columns:1fr 1.45fr 1fr!important}}
/* v9 */
.pol{margin-top:10px}
.pol h2{font-size:17px;line-height:1.25;margin:0 0 8px}
.pol .pg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 300px;gap:14px;align-items:start}
.pol .pcol h2{margin:0 0 10px}.pol .pst6{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:10px}
.pol .pst6 div{border-top:3px solid var(--accent);background:var(--page);padding:7px 9px;font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.35;color:var(--muted)}
.pol .pst6 b{display:block;font:600 18px/1.15 var(--serif);color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:3px}
.pol figure{margin:0}
.pol figure img{width:100%;height:auto;display:block;border:1px solid var(--rule)}
.pol figcaption{font-size:10px;line-height:1.35;color:var(--muted);margin-top:4px}
.pol .src{font-size:10px;line-height:1.4;color:var(--muted);margin:6px 0 0}
@media screen and (max-width:860px){.pol .pg{grid-template-columns:1fr}.pol .pst6{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
.ladimg{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;margin:7px 0 3px}.invh{font:600 9.5px/1.2 var(--mono);letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin:2px 0 4px;padding-top:6px;border-top:1px solid var(--rule)}
.trio{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:10px;margin:4px 0 8px}
.pc{font-size:10.5px;line-height:1.35}
.pc img{width:68px;height:68px;object-fit:cover;display:block;border:1px solid var(--ink);margin-bottom:4px}
.pc b{display:block;font:600 12.5px/1.25 var(--serif)}
.pc .r{display:block;font:500 9.5px/1.3 var(--mono);letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:3px}
.l3x{display:grid;grid-template-columns:236px 1fr;gap:12px;align-items:start;margin:6px 0 4px}
.l3x .art{width:236px}
.l3x .lv{position:absolute;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;white-space:nowrap;color:#1C1410;line-height:1}
.l3x .lv.big{font:600 3.6cqw/1 var(--serif)}
.l3x .lv.sm{font:600 2.9cqw/1 var(--sans)}
.l3x .lv.ctr{font:500 3cqw/1.1 var(--mono);letter-spacing:.04em;border-radius:50%}
.l3x .lg{font-size:11px;line-height:1.35}
.l3x .lg>div{display:grid;grid-template-columns:12px 1fr;gap:6px;margin-bottom:7px}
.l3x .lg i{display:block;width:12px;height:12px;margin-top:2px}
.l3x .lg b{font:600 12px/1.25 var(--serif)}

@media screen and (max-width:860px){.l3x{grid-template-columns:1fr}.l3x .art{margin:0 auto}}
/* v10 */
.head .brand{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:16px;min-width:0}
.head .logo{height:54px;width:auto;display:block;flex:0 0 auto}
.eco{margin:2px 0 8px}
.ecoart{width:84%;margin:0 auto}
.ecoart .lb2{position:absolute;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;white-space:nowrap;background:var(--paper);border:1.5px solid var(--ink);border-radius:99px;color:var(--ink);font:700 1.9cqw/1 var(--sans);letter-spacing:.01em}
.ecoart .hub{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;background:var(--paper);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.ecoart .hub img{width:auto;height:64%;display:block}
.ecoart .lend{position:absolute;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;background:var(--paper);color:var(--accent);font:700 1.9cqw/1.15 var(--sans);border-radius:2cqw}
.ecoart .lend span{font:600 1.55cqw/1.15 var(--sans);color:var(--muted)}
.eco figcaption{font-size:10.5px;line-height:1.4;color:var(--muted);margin-top:4px;text-wrap:balance}
@media screen and (max-width:860px){.head .logo{height:44px}}
/* evidence + review */
.ev,.internal,.legend{display:none}
body.review .ev{display:inline-block;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;margin-left:6px;vertical-align:middle;position:relative;top:-1px}
body.review .ev.d{background:var(--ok)} body.review .ev.p{background:var(--amber)} body.review .ev.n{background:var(--accent)}
body.review .internal{display:block}
body.review .legend{display:flex}
.ribbon{background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper);font:500 11px/1.4 var(--mono);letter-spacing:.04em;padding:8px 16px;text-align:center}
.legend{gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;font:500 10px/1.2 var(--mono);color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 10px;letter-spacing:.04em}
.legend span::before{content:"";display:inline-block;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;margin-right:5px;background:var(--stone)}
.legend .d::before{background:var(--ok)}.legend .p::before{background:var(--amber)}.legend .n::before{background:var(--accent)}
.toggle{position:fixed;right:14px;top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 10px);z-index:20;font:500 10.5px/1 var(--mono);background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--ink);padding:8px 10px;cursor:pointer}
.appx{max-width:1120px;margin:0 auto;padding:26px 36px 40px}
.appx h2{font-size:21px;margin-bottom:6px}
.pr{background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--rule);border-left:4px solid var(--accent);padding:10px 14px;margin:10px 0}
.pr h3{font-size:14.5px;margin-bottom:4px}
.pr .meta{font:500 10px/1.4 var(--mono);color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:6px}
.pr pre{white-space:pre-wrap;word-wrap:break-word;margin:0;font:400 11.5px/1.55 var(--mono);color:var(--ink)}
@media screen and (max-width:860px){
  .sheet{padding:20px 16px 16px}.appx{padding:20px 16px}
  .grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.head{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:8px}
  h1{font-size:23px}.head .side{text-align:left;white-space:normal}
  .row2{grid-template-columns:1fr}.snap{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.kpis{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .toggle{top:auto;bottom:calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px) + 10px)}
}
@page{size:8.5in 11in;margin:0}
@media print{
  html,body{background:var(--page)!important;-webkit-print-color-adjust:exact;print-color-adjust:exact}
  .toggle,.internal,.ev,.legend,.ribbon,.appx{display:none!important}
  .sheet{box-sizing:border-box;width:1088px;max-width:none;margin:0;border:0;padding:38.4px 44px;page-break-after:always;break-after:page;zoom:.75;-webkit-box-decoration-break:clone;box-decoration-break:clone}
  .sheet:last-of-type{page-break-after:auto}
  .grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr!important}
  .figs{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr!important}
  .quad,.strip{break-inside:avoid}
  table.t th,table.t td{white-space:normal}
}

<section class="sheet" id="p0">
  <div class="head">
    <div class="brand"><img class="logo" alt="Cato Digital" src="data:image/webp;base64,"><div>
      <div class="kicker">Cato Digital · GPU equipment financing brief · Page 1</div>
      <h1>Thriving in AI infrastructure financing, in boom or bust</h1>
    </div></div>
    <div class="side">An exclusive invitation</div></div>
  <div class="grid">
    <article class="quad">
      <h2><span class="num">01</span>AI infrastructure: top finance growth market</h2>
      <div class="row2">
        <div><svg viewBox="0 0 300 244" role="img" aria-label="Public GPU-backed debt by year in billions of dollars: 2023 about 2.5, 2024 about 9.3, 2025 6.6, 2026 to October 10 48.4"><line x1="8" y1="204" x2="292" y2="204" stroke="#1C1410" stroke-width="1.4"></line><rect x="14" y="196.2" width="52" height="7.8" fill="#8A7B6A"></rect><text x="40" y="189.2" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#1C1410" text-anchor="middle">$2.5B</text><text x="40" y="224" font-size="15" fill="#4A3F36" text-anchor="middle">2023</text><rect x="82" y="175.2" width="52" height="28.8" fill="#8A7B6A"></rect><text x="108" y="168.2" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#1C1410" text-anchor="middle">$9.3B</text><text x="108" y="224" font-size="15" fill="#4A3F36" text-anchor="middle">2024</text><rect x="150" y="183.5" width="52" height="20.5" fill="#8A7B6A"></rect><text x="176" y="176.5" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#1C1410" text-anchor="middle">$6.6B</text><text x="176" y="224" font-size="15" fill="#4A3F36" text-anchor="middle">2025</text><rect x="218" y="54.0" width="52" height="150.0" fill="#7E32D3"></rect><text x="244" y="47.0" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#1C1410" text-anchor="middle">$48.4B</text><text x="244" y="224" font-size="15" fill="#4A3F36" text-anchor="middle">2026</text><text x="244" y="240" font-size="12.5" fill="#4A3F36" text-anchor="middle">to Oct 10</text></svg><p class="cap">Public GPU-backed debt raised, excl. private deals.</p></div>
        <div><div class="stat"><div class="big">$66.8B</div><p>of publicly announced GPU-backed debt since 2023. Private deals could double this.</p></div>
          <div class="stat"><div class="big ink">SOFR + 2.25–3.0%</div><p>for investment-grade clients (~6.2–6.9% total). Unrated borrowers: SOFR + 4.5–5.5% (~8.4–9.4% total).</p></div></div>
      </div>
      <ol class="proof">
        <li><b>GPU lending is a mainstream asset class.</b> SPV owns hardware; rent repays loans; receivables &amp; GPUs are collateral.</li>
        <li><b>Smart bets carry upside and scale,</b> with 7x growth vs. 2025 already this year.</li>
        <li><b>Top name lenders</b> include JPMorgan, Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, MUFG, Blackstone, Apollo and Macquarie.</li>
      </ol>
    </article>

    <article class="quad">
      <h2><span class="num">02</span>Opportunity: up to $200M for insider ally</h2>
      <ol class="proof">
        <li><b>Opportunity tempered by complexity.</b> It’s hard to find deals; hard to qualify them &amp; manage risk; hard to prep for and price a black swan crash.</li>
        <li><b>Connections &amp; expertise to cut risk &amp; grow volume.</b> Most respected technologists, builders, and operators of AI infrastructure on your side to:
          <img class="ladimg" src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="Five ways the insiders help a lender: 1 find fast-moving opportunities your sales team never sees; 2 help design due diligence and risk management frameworks; 3 vet critical deals beyond your in-house tech expertise; 4 minimize losses on individual defaults or an industry-wide crash; 5 buy for pennies on the dollar when others fail"></li>
        <li><b>Only price: fast &amp; flexible deal evaluation.</b>
          <ul class="sub">
            <li>Your own credit bets or syndication to allies</li>
            <li>Navigate to the right internal &amp; external lender</li>
            <li>No blank checks: everything vetted &amp; priced by your risk team.</li>
            <li>Deals are fast, fair, on best terms relative to the end-client counterparty risk.</li>
          </ul></li>
        <li><b>Strategic partnership target: $200M credit line</b>
          <ul class="sub">
            <li>$3.6M–$1B in insider opportunities detailed in this brief</li>
          </ul></li>
      </ol>
    </article>
  </div>

  <div class="rm"><div class="band"><h2>Roadmap to your success in AI infrastructure finance</h2></div>
  <div class="row3">
    <article class="quad">
      <h2><span class="num">03</span>Short term: find the deal, evaluate fast, reduce risk</h2>
      <ol class="proof">
        <li><b>Most deals close quickly and privately.</b> Outsiders rarely get a seat.</li>
        <li><b>Decision time is compressed.</b> OEM lead times grow, customers want fast delivery, so financing decisions happen in weeks.</li>
        <li><b>Winning takes the right connections &amp; model.</b> You need intros to deals early and a repeatable way to price or reject deals fast.</li>
      </ol>
      
    </article>

    <article class="quad">
      <h2><span class="num">04</span>Medium term: manage the risks better than others</h2>
      <ol class="proof">
        <li><b>Look past the balance sheet.</b> Uptime record, delivery discipline, site readiness &amp; customer concentration predict outcomes better.</li>
        <li><b>Know where GPU financings get hurt.</b><div class="tiles">
        <div class="tile"><b><span class="n">A</span>No firm demand</b><span class="d">Spot pricing or soft commitments.</span></div>
        <div class="tile"><b><span class="n">B</span>Counterparty credit</b><span class="d">Defaults on long-term obligations.</span></div>
        <div class="tile"><b><span class="n">C</span>Concentration</b><span class="d">By client or sector.</span></div>
        <div class="tile"><b><span class="n">D</span>Supply</b><span class="d">Servers late or overpriced.</span></div>
        <div class="tile"><b><span class="n">E</span>Site and consent</b><span class="d">Power, cooling, or local approval not ready.</span></div>
        <div class="tile"><b><span class="n">F</span>Build and operations</b><span class="d">Outages, service credits, early exit.</span></div>
        <div class="tile"><b><span class="n">G</span>Obsolescence</b><span class="d">New GPU gen lowers rental rates &amp; resale value.</span></div>
        <div class="tile"><b><span class="n">H</span>The cycle</b><span class="d">AI spending pulls back before the loan is repaid.</span></div>
      </div></li>
      </ol>
    </article>

    <article class="quad">
      <h2><span class="num">05</span>Long term: come out on top in a market-wide downturn</h2>
      <ol class="proof">
        <li><b>Dot-com era blueprint:</b> Big names like Exodus and Cable &amp; Wireless collapsed; well-run upstart Savvis bought them for pennies. GI Partners built Digital Realty from 21 distressed data centers.</li>
        <li><b>Plan for the crash.</b> Today, downside is capped by scarcity. Future correlated defaults may create GPU liquidation glut.</li>
        <li><b>Whether in 6 months or 6 years, be ready to profit on the dip.</b> Winners have structure &amp; partners to extract value when everyone else sells.</li>
      </ol>
    </article>
  </div>

  </div>
  <article class="quad pol">
    <div class="pg">
      <div class="pcol"><h2>New political risk: anti-data center public sentiment</h2>
      <div class="pst6">
        <div><b>75+ / $130B</b>projects blocked or delayed in Q1 2026 alone</div>
        <div><b>14 states</b>with statewide moratorium proposals</div>
        <div><b>12 of 34</b>new governors back bans / moratoriums; 32 / 34 for tighter rules</div>
        <div><b>44 of 45</b>counted local data center ballot measures restricted them</div>
        <div><b>3 states</b>with active pauses<br>NY; Texas; Ohio (tax exemptions)</div>
        <div><b>New on-grid build</b>Biggest predictor of lender risk</div>
      </div></div>
      <figure>
        <img alt="Map of the United States shaded by the number of data center-related ballot measures by state, with Ohio darkest and hatching on Texas, Georgia, Ohio, Michigan and Wisconsin" src="data:image/webp;base64,">
        
      </figure>
    </div>
    
  </article>

    <article class="quad">
      <h2><span class="num">03</span>Mid-term: Conscious Compute, the model the industry will need</h2>
      <p>Opposition to new data centers is rising &amp; moratorium bills are moving in 14 states. Operators will have to show low waste, small footprints and community integration. Cato already works this way.</p>
      <ul class="plain">
        <li class="ic"><img class="icn" alt="" src="data:image/webp;base64,"><div><b>Second-life equipment.</b> Used servers are redeployed instead of scrapped, then pass to ITAD partners at EOL, keeping electronic waste out of landfills.</div></li>
        <li class="ic"><img class="icn" alt="" src="data:image/webp;base64,"><div><b>Stranded power.</b> Cato’s patented M9 system uses power that data centers have already built but cannot sell, so no new capacity is needed.</div></li>
        <li class="ic"><img class="icn" alt="" src="data:image/webp;base64,"><div><b>Efficient design.</b> Air-cooled B300 racks draw about 7.5 kW / server vs. 14 kW nameplate.</div></li>
        <li class="ic"><img class="icn" alt="" src="data:image/webp;base64,"><div><b>Standards leadership.</b> iMasons’ Climate Accord has 250+ members including AWS, Google, Meta, Microsoft, Schneider Electric and Digital Realty, while its Social Accord covers community engagement.</div></li>
        <li class="ic"><img class="icn" alt="" src="data:image/webp;base64,"><div><b>Pioneering adopter of Conscious Compute standards.</b> Expected to receive one of the first independent certifications for responsible data centers on its 2027 launch.</div></li>
      </ul>
    </article>

    <article class="quad">
      <h2><span class="num">04</span>Long term: building back better after an AI crash</h2>
      <p>If a market-wide downturn comes, Cato is the partner you want holding the servers that came back to you as collateral on failed loans.</p>
      <div class="l3x">
        <div class="art" style="aspect-ratio:1/1"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="Circular graphic of three server lives: 01 frontier use by hyperscalers, 02 re-contract with Cato at lower rates, 03 parts and recycling"><div class="lv big" style="left:32.06%;top:10.93%;width:35.73%;height:7.02%">Frontier life</div><div class="lv sm" style="left:35.65%;top:18.98%;width:28.55%;height:3.91%">Hyperscalers</div><div class="lv big" style="left:63.80%;top:47.69%;width:31.34%;height:7.34%">Cato re-contract</div><div class="lv sm" style="left:65.71%;top:56.14%;width:27.27%;height:4.70%">Lower rates</div><div class="lv big" style="left:5.34%;top:46.09%;width:30.70%;height:7.50%">Parts</div><div class="lv sm" style="left:7.42%;top:54.86%;width:26.87%;height:4.70%">Recycle, ITAD</div><div class="lv ctr" style="left:39.47%;top:41.47%;width:20.73%;height:20.73%">3<br>lives</div></div>
        <div>
          <div class="lg">
            <div><i style="background:var(--ink)"></i><span><b>Life 1 · frontier.</b> Hyperscalers run the newest GPUs on the most intense workloads.</span></div>
            <div><i style="background:var(--accent)"></i><span><b>Life 2 · Cato.</b> Lighter workloads: inference, development &amp; batch on older hardware.</span></div>
            <div><i style="background:var(--stone)"></i><span><b>Life 3 · parts.</b> Spares and recycling keep the fleet running, then ITAD.</span></div>
          </div>
          <div class="fade"></div>
          <div class="fadel"><span>Workload intensity steps down</span><span>The asset keeps earning</span></div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <p style="margin-top:8px"><b>Insulated from other deals.</b> Each financing sits in its own SPV, so collateral stays clear of other obligations.</p>
      <p><b>A plan for lives two and three.</b> Path to standing step-in and re-marketing rights for collateral from your other defaults.</p>
      <p class="cap">For these B300 GPUs, Cato buys new and runs life 1 under a 36-month take-or-pay contract. Lives 2 and 3 are upside / backstop, not your underwriting.</p>

    <!-- Q4 STRUCTURE -->
    <article class="quad">
      <h2><span class="num">04</span>Deal structure and options</h2>
      <ul class="plain">
        <li><b>Target.</b> A revolving, delayed-draw facility in a standalone SPV. Each newly signed customer contract becomes a draw request with fast approval, and customer payments repay it.</li>
        <li><b>Other options.</b> A single-tranche loan or lease for the first 22 servers, vendor financing, sale-leaseback, receivables financing against contract invoices, and impact-finance participation.</li>
        <li><b>Lender incentives.</b> Open to equity kickers, warrants or fee structures for lenders who commit early.</li>
        <li><b>Collateral.</b> Serial-numbered, high-demand servers plus assigned customer payments and deposits. Cato’s legacy business stays outside the structure.</li>
        <li><b>Parent equity.</b> The $10M SAFE (opportunity 2) is raised in parallel: $25M cap, 20% discount, $6.5M committed.</li>
      </ul>
